craft_notes: Sthāyin: shut-eye-method (#2 dark-door: eyes closed). Sanskrit: nimīlyādau...bhāvayaṃs tanmayo bhavet → L4 keeps sequence closed→before→spread→become. Rows: row 2 (spread→made-of-that). Close: may be (optative — becoming offered). Rejected: 'blackout' — killed: black lustre kept (kṛṣṇābha — lustrous, not void); 'imagines' — killed: contemplating kept.

lines: Eyes closed first, black lustre before:
Bhairava's form spread — made-of-that may be.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evam eva nimīlyādau netre kṛṣṇābham agrataḥ | prasārya bhairavaṃ rūpam bhāvayaṃs tanmayo bhavet

reads_against.argmap: What from closed eyes? → Spreading the form before closed eyes, one becomes made-of-that.
c1_essence: Eyes closed, black before: contemplating, made of that.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with adbhuta (stillness startled by its own gates)
